additional_info.subject: ID0476500-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002441] Check on logs CRM:02889001057
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
After reviewing the issue you reported. and based on the information provided we've identified the cause of the payment not being immediately accepted. For both sessions, the issue stemmed from a brief, intermittent interruption in the OCPP connection between the charging station and the central system, as shown in the attached log:
During this brief period, while the payment authorization was affected, the charger remained active The OCPP connection quickly re-established itself, and the system returned to normal operation shortly thereafter.
Please let us know if you have any further questions or concerns. If not, we will close the ticket within 48 hours
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
